subscription_enabled.description: Master switch for subscription acquisition UI and paywall entry points.

subscription_plans_json.description: Optional JSON array of subscription plans. Google Play Billing prices override these display prices when available.

privacy_policy_url.description: Browser URL opened from Privacy Policy links in Settings, Profile, and Privacy & Security.

terms_and_conditions_url.description: Browser URL opened from Terms & Conditions links in Settings and Profile.

app_share_url.description: App URL included when users share LumoraAI from Settings or Profile.

inter_all_interval_ms.description: Minimum interval before Inter_all can show after the last fullscreen impression, in milliseconds (0-600000). Replaces the click-count requirement; overrides legacy Inter_all cooldowns.
